_comment: Quest 3 tier pushed to the headset as hm_data/quest_settings.json by Tools/deploy_data.ps1 -Push (kept if the headset has its own; -ReplaceSettings replaces it). Keys: Assets/VR/Runtime/VrSettings.cs, docs/SPLAT_DANCERS.md 'Quest'. Never lay this out in Builds/data: a Windows player reads quest_settings.json from its data folder too. 2026-11-16 (owner: a steady 72 fps, the splats may be compressed more): the distilled 10k set (dancecap quest_distill, PSNR ~40 against the full avatar) on the low-res splat layer at half the eye buffer (fixed upright since 2026-10-21, with its own low-res splat depth), MSAA 2x (the hair cards it was raised for are hidden under the splats), alpha cutoff 0.05, sort every 2. Before: quest_15k on the full-res composite at 4x MSAA, demo 49 fps / 17.0 ms GPU (Builds/quest_bench_1116).
